<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Rally:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty surged over 500 points, reclaiming the 24,200 level, driven by gains in major banking stocks following positive US inflation data.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy:</strong> The RBI has kept the repo rate unchanged and projects India’s real GDP growth for the current fiscal year at 6.9%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>IPO Activity:</strong> The Indian Gas Exchange has filed preliminary papers with SEBI for an IPO, with parent company IEX planning to divest a portion of its stake.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>US Inflation Impact:</strong> Asian markets, including the Kospi and Nikkei, rallied significantly after US inflation dropped to 2.6%, cooling global rate hike expectations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxOMjFmb2JIUWdmQkFsR0hlSEpHNUtlQm5kMVVJeV9XVTA4RE1kZHZ6TGdNTHFSZ09tQnZuQm1GbWVYVXViNFE1N0xaZ2NIaXVydmFGSWpXWFVxdjlkTnFEQWZfWjlGUk1DQkxSblR4S1BnMEIxQU5CSElHaXVhVUloWUVwZG4tMDhnSmlDRE96S0luVFVrODdiUTIwWnd2YjdqUVdHcllncXJaZzFZai1xMmROY1p0ZFBpejM4TEYtYm9BNmdfaUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bond Yields:</strong> Indian 10-year bond yields dipped to 6.76% as softer US inflation data reduced pressure on domestic interest rate outlooks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
